Job Summary
The establishment of a GDS Digital Engineering Leader for TMT is critical to accelerate EY GDS Consultings growth in a sector experiencing rapid, technology-led disruption and innovation. TMT clients, including telecommunications service providers, digital media companies, streaming platforms, software and hardware technology firms, and emerging tech innovators are significantly increasing investments in platform and product engineering, cloud-native modernization, AI-enabled software development lifecycle (SDLC) transformation, digital content and data platforms,
OSS/BSS modernization, 5G/6G networks and edge computing, and cyberresilient engineering.
While demand is robust, GDS participation today tends to be capabilityspecific and opportunity-driven, which limits the ability to present a cohesive, end-to-end Digital Engineering value proposition tailored to the unique challenges and fast-paced evolution of the TMT landscape. This role provides dedicated executive leadership to transition from fragmented delivery models to a solution-led, engineering-centric approach, enhancing GDS integration, improving win-rates, and ensuring delivery predictability across TMT sub-sectors.
Essential Functions
  • Build strong relationships with TMT sector leaders, account leaders, and EY Member Firms to influence account plans and drive growth.
  • Establish a solution and FieldofPlaybased operating model for TMT Digital Engineering (product & platform engineering, cloud modernization, integration/API ecosystems, DevSecOps, QA automation, SRE).
  • Ensure GDS participation in large technology and transformation deals, supporting solution shaping, pricing, estimates, and RFP responses.
  • Participate in and lead key client orals, demonstrating EY/GDS engineering capability, assets, and delivery excellence.
  • Host CXOlevel client visits to GDS to showcase engineering studios, accelerators, innovation, and rightshoring models.
  • Build scalable rightshoring delivery models, leveraging offshore and nearshore strengths while ensuring reliability and compliance.
  • Establish delivery governance across pipeline, demand, delivery health, and cost of delivery.
  • Build and mentor an engineering leadership bench (SM/EDs) aligned to priority TMT portfolios.
  • Drive strategic collaboration with key technology partners, startups, and academic institutions within the TMT ecosystem to co-create cutting-edge engineering solutions and accelerate digital transformation across TMT sectors.
  • Ensure all engineering solutions and delivery practices within EY GDS adhere to TMT industry-specific regulatory requirements, safety standards,and cybersecurity protocols, maintaining the highest standards of compliance and risk management.
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities
  • Solve complex client problems by combining engineering, cloud, AIenabled SDLC, data platforms, and security.
  • Provide multiple solution options and guide TMT clients toward outcomedriven engineering roadmaps.
  • Apply pragmatic, scalable engineering approaches to modernization, scale, and reliability challenges.
  • Use automation and standardization to improve delivery predictability and reduce cycle times.
Education & Experience
  • Minimum 22-25 years of professional experience in technology consulting / digital engineering, including 8+ years in senior leadership roles, with deep exposure to TMT clients and transformation programs.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives involving platform and product engineering, cloud-native modernization, AI/ML-enabled software development lifecycle (SDLC) transformation, OSS/BSS modernization, 5G/edge computing deployments, digital content and data platform strategies, and cyber-resilient engineering within fast-evolving TMT environments.
Desired experience
Leading largescale programs in platform/product engineering, cloudnative modernization, DevSecOps, CI/CD, integration/API platforms, QA automation, SRE
Strong understanding of TMT operating models:
  • Technology: platform scale, productled growth, engineering productivity o Media: content platforms, streaming architectures, data & personalization
  • Telecom: OSS/BSS modernization, digital channels, networkadjacent platforms
  • Proven ability to sell and deliver large engagements using global delivery models
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary, multigeo delivery teams
